These enhancements have allowed them to become a highly specialized army with a great deal of mobility, giving them an edge in rough environments. These cults have embraced the inevitable transcendence of machines, and work to merge themselves with their machines, but this process has caused them to become isolated and outcast from the rest of humanity. Despite their faith and patience, the promise of transcendence still eludes them even after centuries of devotion. The Machine Cult trace their origins to old Earth. Their cult has long believed that the advancement of technology is inevitable and eventually humanity itself will be surpassed by the machine in an e... [Read more lore on our website](https://www.onepagerules.com/factions/machine-cult) ### Army-Wide Special Rules Machine-Fog: When units where all models have this rule are shot or charged from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls. ### Special Rules Bounding: When this unit is activated, you may place all models with this rule in it anywhere fully within D3+1" of their position. Crossing Attack(X): Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Grounded Stealth: If a unit where all models have this rule has most of them within 1" of terrain, enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking them. Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Melee Slayer: When this model charges, its weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(3) or higher. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Piercing Debuff: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which loses AP(+1) when attacking once (next time the effect would apply). Shred: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound. Strafing: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way. Surge: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hits (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Machine-Fog Boost Aura: This model and its unit get Machine-Fog Boost. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rending when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Rending when shooting. Teleport Aura: This model and its unit get Teleport. Unpredictable Fighter Aura: This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter. Read more ### Spells Cyborg Assault (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Hit & Run Shooter once (next time the effect would apply). Power Beam (1): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1]. Shrouding Incense (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Machine-Fog Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Searing Shrapnel (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 4 hits with AP(1) and Lacerate. Corrode Weapons (3): Pick up to three enemy units within 18", which loses AP(1) when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Crushing Force (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(2). ### Units ### Heroes High Cyborg-Priest [1] Qua 4+Def 4+ 155pts Revolver(12", A3, AP(1)), Axe-Halberd(A6, AP(4))
